operation.name: GetUserByID
operation.query: select intUserId, user_name, email, User_Id, User_level, User_Type, User_code, GBVUser from tbl_Users where intUserId = @UserId

operation.name: GetUsers
operation.query: select intUserId, user_name, email, User_Id, User_level, User_Type, User_code, GBVUser from tbl_Users order by intUserId asc
